snippet.title: Pitfalls 64 Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Take on a brutal, platforming gauntlet in Pitfalls 64! Clamber upwardly as a homesick gnome in search of his way back home, butt proceed with caution; one careless slip could spell a hard bonk back to the bottom...
